stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for the foliage of a very old dark oak in a grounded dark-fantasy forest. The canopy should feel heavier and more shadowed than ordinary oak: dense clusters of mature leaves, deep muted green, cool olive and brown-green undertones, with leathery surfaces and small signs of age, insects and poor light. Interior foliage disappears into rich darkness while outer leaves catch subdued diffuse light. Avoid black foliage, gothic ornament, magical purple tint, uniform hedge density or bright healthy garden green. The tree is ominous because of mass, age and shade, not supernatural effects. Establish a distinctive old-forest foliage language—dense, cool, weathered and ancient—while leaving the game's actual leaf silhouette and distribution untouched.
